page: Google Cloud Platform ct5p-hightpu-2t is a specialized accelerator instance belonging to the ct5p family. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 224.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 2.15 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The primary differentiator of this server type is the integration of two Google TPU v5p accelerators, providing a total of 190 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. This hardware configuration is designed specifically for accelerating tensor computations and machine learning workloads, bypassing traditional GPU architectures in favor of Google's proprietary Tensor Processing Unit design.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ct5p-hightpu-2t consolidates massive parallel processing power and specialized matrix multiplication hardware into a single node, reducing the overhead of multi-node cluster orchestration for medium-scale training. This server is optimized for workloads such as deep learning model training, large-scale neural network inference, and advanced data science pipelines that can leverage Google TPU architectures.
